title: Compatible term after a bad extension
statement: Let $\phi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction whose restricted Boolean function is nonconstant. Fix a free coordinate occurring in the first compatible term and set it to that term's required sign, obtaining the bad extension of $\rho$. Then at least one term of $\phi$ is compatible with this extended restriction.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on n coordinates
ρ is a restriction for which the restricted Boolean function is nonconstant
